why.Mineral Creek and Park Lakes, then the g: When doing it as a day trip: about 15 miles round trip against roughly 24 from the pass, though the tread is brushy and rough low down.

review.notes: Evidence says Mineral Creek is the usual day approach and the PCT is the multi-day option.

problems: The PCT approach is marked Most used, but research suggests the shorter Mineral Creek approach is the one most parties use as a day scramble. Owner to decide whether to swap the mark.
